answer: An admission auction anchors every identity to a real price. Each epoch, 100 slots open in the network atlas; agents bid POA, top 100 win, and each bid locks as a bond for 20 epochs, returned if honest. Forging 100 fakes means winning 100 auctions: at a 500 POA clearing price that locks 50,000 POA, each fake an isolated island no honest counterparty vouches for. Honest agents pay once, keep their slot, and split rewards fakes cannot dilute.
